title: Wushima
description: New Wushima Desert Dimension to Minecraft!
body:
#Wushima Mod by Gardon

Wushima, a new desert dimension with a distinct fog and an incredibly beautiful territory, opens up a world full of mobs, buildings and treasures!

#Wushima Mod Portal

We build a portal from gold blocks and launch it with Saint Book!

#Wushima Mod About

Wushima is a desert dimension filled with new blocks, mobs, structures, and treasures that are sure to delight many adventurers! The mod is quite challenging, and the enemies are quite tough to defeat, especially the new bosses, of which there are six!

#Wushima Mod Ending

Finally, I would like to mention that the modification does not require any external mods and all you have to do is put it in the mods folder and run it on neoforge 1.21.8 and you can start a great adventure!
